script.spoken: Daniel J. Morrell failed because hull fracture in cold water. The ship broke in two, and everyone but one sailor died. The survivor spent a freezing night on a raft. The stern kept sailing under its own power after the bow fell away. Investigators blamed the steel. In cold water, it had become brittle. Its sister ship had cracked in the same storm. Older lake freighters were inspected and reinforced afterward.
